author: GameSpot
description:
Valve confirmed their new hardware (Steam Machine, Frame, Controller), will no longer be making their early 2026 launch plans due to limited availability of critical components like memory and storage caused by the monopolization of supply for AI datacenters.

Watch the full Kurt & Lucy Gotcha Covered Episode: https://youtu.be/WWmey233t_U

#steam #steamhardware #gaming
title: The RAM Shortage Comes for Valve
